description: MP3 metadata mapping based on ID3v2 specification and audiobook usage patterns

TIT2.description: Title/songname/content description - actual name of the piece

TALB.description: Album/Movie/Show title - title of the recording from which audio is taken

TPE1.audiobook_usage: Narrator name or 'Various' for multiple narrators

TPE2.audiobook_usage: Album artist (typically author name for audiobooks)

TDRC.description: Recording time - timestamp when audio was recorded (ID3v2.4)

TRCK.description: Track number/Position in set - order number on original recording

TPOS.description: Part of a set - which part of a set the audio came from

TLEN.description: Length - length of audiofile in milliseconds

TPUB.description: Publisher - name of the label or publisher

TCOP.description: Copyright message - copyright holder of original sound
TCOP.audiobook_usage: Copyright information (must begin with year and space)

TENC.description: Encoded by - person or organization that encoded the audio
TENC.audiobook_usage: Encoding software or person who created the files

COMM.description: Comments - full text information that doesn't fit other frames

APIC.description: Attached picture - picture directly related to audio file
APIC.audiobook_usage: Book cover art or author photo

USLT.description: Unsynchronised lyrics/text transcription - lyrics or text transcription
USLT.audiobook_usage: Chapter text or book excerpt (if applicable)

TIT1.description: Content group description - larger category of sounds/music

TIT3.description: Subtitle/Description refinement - information related to title

TLAN.description: Language - languages of text or lyrics spoken/sung

audiobook_specific_notes.track_numbering: Use TRCK for chapter numbers, TPOS for disc numbers in multi-disc sets
audiobook_specific_notes.artist_vs_author: TPE1 for narrator, TPE2 for album artist (author), TCOM for composer (author)
audiobook_specific_notes.title_hierarchy: TALB for book title, TIT2 for chapter title, TIT1 for series, TIT3 for subtitle
audiobook_specific_notes.cover_art: APIC with picture type $03 (Cover front) for book cover
audiobook_specific_notes.copyright: TCOP must begin with year and space character
audiobook_specific_notes.encoding_compatibility: Use ISO-8859-1 or UTF-16 encoding, specified by first byte

differences_from_music.content_focus: Chapters instead of songs, books instead of albums
differences_from_music.artist_semantics: Narrator vs singer, author vs composer/songwriter
differences_from_music.metadata_richness: Often includes detailed descriptions, series information
differences_from_music.cover_art_importance: Book cover is primary visual identifier
